There's this. I have a little news that I'd like to give you as well and it has to do with this program.
I have been absolutely delighted for the last five years to be working with some of the most talented people in television news.
Just really stellar, stellar producers, writers, researchers, reporters, just remarkable people here at CNN.
And so it is really tough to tell you that I'm going to be leaving.
kind of. It's sort of weird, but I'm going to leave this time slot at 12 noon, and I'm
going to make the jump and follow my friends over at HLN. We've already heard that
Michaela Perera has jumped over there, Erica Hills over there, Robin Need. So I'm going
to jump over to Primetime on HLN 8 PM in the fall. Super excited to do it. We're going
to bring a really unique brand of social and legal issues oriented programming to that
eight p.m. spot. Lots more news and details about it will follow, but I just wanted to let
you know what a privilege it's been at 12 noon to be with you every day. And if you
will just indulge me for a moment, you see me all the time, but you don't see Christina
or Sanya or Lindsay or Robin or Chris or Scotty or Gus and Alex and Ariel and Lamy and
Tandu and Dave. This is my family. And every single day it is a delight to get up at 430
in the morning and be with them and I say that honestly. So thank you for being here
at 12 noon every day. Still going to be here for a few more weeks from the 23rd it will
be our last program here but I'll be seeing you over on HLN at 8 p.m. very exciting time
for us all here at CNN and HLN and I will still be doing a lot of stuff on CNN as well.
I'll be bringing legal analysis and I'll be guest representing and talking about the
the stories of the day, the justice oriented issues of the day over here on CNN's programming.
So I'm not going very far and I'll still be working with all of these extraordinary people
on a pretty regular basis.
For now, that's it for today.
I've said enough.
